notes.lead_decision: no harness-core -> kernel-bindings edge: the typed command context lives in hsk-studio-accord (additive, new types only, no changed signature); kernel-bindings maps Envelope onto it through one adapter (src/context.rs CommandContextWire::to_context/from_context). No module edge added, no root input changed.
notes.command_context_fields: accord CommandContext = actor, client_session (ClientSessionId), command (Option<CommandId>, a RUN_COMMANDS id), base_revision, correlation (CorrelationId u64), causation (Option<CausationId>). The wire form omits the actor (the envelope's actor is the command's); BridgePorts::set_command_context refuses (sends nothing) a request for another actor.
notes.envelope_correlation: Envelope.correlation_id unchanged: adapter.rs mints it per exchange and matches the reply on it (documented on the field and in context.rs); the command correlation is the separate typed field command.correlation; test reply_matching_uses_the_exchange_id_not_the_command_correlation (a host echoing the command correlation is refused as stale, exactly as before).
notes.run_attribution: Run mints one CommandContext per mutating command (rename/visible/opacity/blend/panel_set/set_tiles/set_vector_paths/restructure/*_and_entry/submit_sequence(_edits)/undo/redo/action.play); a harness-owned operation without a command id (summary, verify, refusals with a session) gets a correlation-only context so its frame never carries n; op record keys actor, command_id, correlation, causation added (n, revision kept); op detail adds correlation_id (the chronicle/timeline transaction's); observe json of a delivered report adds the receipt correlation. HistoryStep gains ctx + revision; Run::history keeps undo/redo label arrays and adds undo_steps/redo_steps. Entry-only steps and entry refusals of *_and_entry keep their command's context (last_command).
notes.session_frames_gap: session-owned report frames (open, submit, save, checkpoint) keep the session's own operation counter as correlation (Session::settle_with -> emit_report(self.operations)); session is not an owned path (SMB-JOB-ADMISSION-1 owns it). The open record has no command context (correlation null). The harness-owned frames, patches, timeline and multicam steps carry the command correlation (tests/run_attribution.rs no_frame_patch_or_record_carries_the_op_ordinal).

notes.rule_4e: the brief proposed a self dev-dependency or required-features for the crates' own tests. A self dev-dependency changes Cargo.lock (round step 0 runs cargo metadata --locked) and is a path dev edge the workspace probe accepts only from root dev-allowed metadata (a self loop is a cycle for tools/edges.py); required-features would compile the tests to zero in the current round units. So the tests build their own RunContext instead: harness-core tests/support/mod.rs test_context(), harness-view tests/support_context/mod.rs context()/viewer()/viewer_with() (Viewer::with_context). Every harness-core and harness-view test runs in the existing round units (harness-core default, harness-view [viewer] and [desktop, audio-batch]) with no new unit; harness enables asset-local-test-host in its normal dependencies, so its tests and CLI use asset_local_test_context and Viewer::new in every harness unit. No steward unit needed.
